Topics · Is there a God?

Can many weak arguments add up to anything?

Ten leaky buckets hold no water, says the objection. But a rope is no chain. When does evidence add up?

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٌ تَنتَشِرُونَ٢٠ وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ٢١ وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْعَـٰلِمِينَ٢٢ وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبْتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ٢٣ وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَيُحْىِۦ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ٢٤﴾

Translation of the meaning

And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth]. And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought. And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge. And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen. And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.

Quran · Ar-Rum 30:20-24

Translation

Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

Original · Hebrew

הֲֽ֝לֹא־בַ֭בֶּטֶן עֹשֵׂ֣נִי עָשָׂ֑הוּ וַ֝יְכֻנֶ֗נּוּ בָּרֶ֥חֶם אֶחָֽד׃

Job · 31:15

World English Bible

Take the objection at full strength. Ten leaky buckets hold no water. If each argument has a hole, why would stacking them help? That is right when every bucket leaks in the same place. It fails for evidence of different kinds. A judge does not convict on a footprint alone, or a motive alone, or a receipt alone. Together they can settle a case. This passage offers no single proof. It walks through separate things, calls each a sign, and leaves you to notice where they point.

A question for you

Which picture fits how you weigh a big question?

If you sayA chain: as strong as its weakest link.
ThenThat is the right picture for a proof, where one bad step ruins everything. It is why this app does not rest on one proof of God.
If you sayA rope: many strands, none carrying all the weight.
ThenThat is the right picture for a case, and courts and historians work by it. It still depends on the strands being real.
If you sayNeither. Weak is weak.
ThenThen each strand has to show some strength of its own, and that is a fair demand.

﴿سَنُرِيهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فِى ٱلْـَٔافَاقِ وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَهُمْ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ أَوَلَمْ يَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ أَنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ﴾

1 Kings · 8:57-60

World English Bible

What are the strands? That anything exists at all, when it need not. That it is ordered, and that the order can be grasped. That minds arose which grasp it. That some acts are truly wrong. That people everywhere reach toward something greater. One account covers all five: a Source with mind and goodness. Rival accounts can explain each, usually with a separate story. This verse describes signs outside and within, until the matter becomes clear. Clarity, it says, takes time.

A question for you

Which of these strands carries the most weight for you?

If you sayThat anything exists at all.
ThenThat is the deepest of them, and it has its own question.
If you sayThat the world can be understood.
ThenThen you are trusting reason, and that trust is itself worth asking about.
If you sayThat some acts are truly wrong.
ThenThen you are starting from dignity or conscience, and there is a road that begins there.
If you sayNone of them yet.
ThenThen the strands are still separate for you, and that is an honest result.

Part 3 of 3

﴿إِنَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ٣ وَفِى خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُوقِنُونَ٤ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزْقٍ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَـٰحِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ٥﴾

Translation of the meaning

Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers. And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith]. And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allāh sends down from the sky of provision [i.e., rain] and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.

Quran · Al-Jathiyah 45:3-5

Translation

God Yahweh, he who created the heavens and stretched them out, he who spread out the earth and that which comes out of it, he who gives breath to its people and spirit to those who walk in it, says:

Original · Hebrew

כֹּֽה־אָמַ֞ר הָאֵ֣ל ׀ יְהוָ֗ה בּוֹרֵ֤א הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְנ֣וֹטֵיהֶ֔ם רֹקַ֥ע הָאָ֖רֶץ וְצֶאֱצָאֶ֑יהָ נֹתֵ֤ן נְשָׁמָה֙ לָעָ֣ם עָלֶ֔יהָ וְר֖וּחַ לַהֹלְכִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃

Isaiah · 42:5

World English Bible

Now the weaknesses. The strands may not be independent: if one account of mind also explains morality, two strands become one. Each may have a natural account. And how likely you thought God was at the start shifts where you finish, so two honest people can weigh the same evidence and differ. A cumulative case gives no certainty. It gives a judgment about which account fits best. This passage turns the same signs toward three kinds of people: those who believe, those who are sure, those who reason.

A question for you

How sure would a case like this need to make you, before it mattered?

If you sayCertain. Nothing less.
ThenThen no cumulative case will do, for this or for most things. That standard is worth looking at.
If you sayMore likely than not.
ThenThen the question is what you would do with that.
If you sayI would want to test the strands one by one.
ThenGood. Each strand has a Step of its own, and each states its limit.
